schedule_1_shipping_policy.title: Shipping Policy
schedule_1_shipping_policy.shipping_introduction: Welcome to Asoebi Africa! We strive to ensure your shopping experience is seamless from the moment you place your order to delivery. Please read our Shipping Policy below for all the details you need.
schedule_1_shipping_policy.1_shipping_locations: We currently deliver to only Lagos Nigeria. International shipping is not available at this time.
2_processing_time: All orders are processed within 1-3 business days (excluding public holidays).
Orders placed after 4:00 PM (WAT) will be processed on the next business day.

3_delivery_time.lagos_state: Delivery within 1-2 business days after processing.

schedule_1_shipping_policy.4_shipping_costs: Shipping fees are calculated at checkout based on your location.
schedule_1_shipping_policy.5_order_tracking: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a confirmation email or SMS with a tracking number. You can track your order through our website or app.
schedule_1_shipping_policy.6_failed_deliveries: If delivery fails due to an incorrect address or inability to contact the recipient, the package will be returned to us. Re-delivery fees will apply.

return_policy.title: Return Policy
return_policy.description: At Asoebi.Africa, customer satisfaction is our priority. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, please return the item while the Carrier is still at your door.
